This is release {{VERSION}}.

## iOS and iPadOS

Install or update Colibri Social from the [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/colibri-social/id6790551269).

## Android

Install or update Colibri Social from [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=social.colibri.app).

To sideload, download `Colibri.Social_{{ANDROID_VERSION}}_universal.apk` below.

## macOS

Install or update Colibri Social from the [Mac App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/colibri-social/id6790551269).

With Homebrew:

```sh
brew install --cask colibri-social/tap/colibri-social
```

If you installed the beta cask, uninstall `colibri-social-beta` first. The two casks conflict.

To install manually, download `Colibri.Social_{{VERSION}}_universal.dmg` below.

## Windows

Install or update Colibri Social from the [Microsoft Store](https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9P8Q77FCCSWR).

With Scoop:

```sh
scoop bucket add colibri-social https://github.com/colibri-social/scoop-bucket
scoop install colibri-social/colibri-social
```

To install manually, download `Colibri.Social_{{VERSION}}_x64-setup.exe` below.

## Linux

Download the package for your distribution and architecture below:

| Format | x86_64 | arm64 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| AppImage | `Colibri.Social_{{VERSION}}_amd64.AppImage` | `Colibri.Social_{{VERSION}}_aarch64.AppImage` |
| Debian and Ubuntu | `Colibri.Social_{{VERSION}}_amd64.deb` | `Colibri.Social_{{VERSION}}_arm64.deb` |
| Fedora and openSUSE | `Colibri.Social-{{VERSION}}-1.x86_64.rpm` | `Colibri.Social-{{VERSION}}-1.aarch64.rpm` |

The desktop builds update themselves. If you run into problems, send a DM to @colibri.social on Bluesky.
